title: Global cohort-income and origin-output optima need not select the same migration rate
checked_scope: The source's homogeneous one-date Cobb–Douglas origin production model with constant positive foreign net earnings.
significance: Proves strict global concavity, unique cohort-income optimum and exact ordering relative to the origin-production optimum, including a closed-form no-remittance case.
